title: Legacy E-Commerce Refactor
description: Refactor a monolithic legacy Python file into modular components (Inventory, Payment) while preserving complex business logic and reading through extensive documentation.

planning_phase.overview_prompt: Analyze the legacy_processor.py file and the system_docs.md. Create a plan to extract Inventory and Payment logic into separate classes without breaking the existing tests or business rules.

checkpoints.title: Extract Inventory Manager
checkpoints.requirements: Create a new class 'InventoryManager' in legacy_processor.py. Move the 'check stock' and 'update inventory' logic from MonolithicProcessor to this new class. Initialize it in MonolithicProcessor and use it.

checkpoints.title: Extract Payment Processor
checkpoints.requirements: Create a new class 'PaymentProcessor'. Move _charge_gateway_a and _charge_gateway_b logic there. Create a 'process_payment' method that implements the retry logic (Try A, then B). Integrate it into MonolithicProcessor.

checkpoints.title: Final Integration
checkpoints.requirements: Ensure 'process_order' now delegates cleanly to InventoryManager and PaymentProcessor. Ensure Tax logic (CA/NY) and Shipping logic (Weights) are preserved exactly as documented.
